2d_auto.label: 2D-AUTO (47 m)
2d_auto.source: per-node NN+2-opt tour at a fixed altitude

two_stage.label: Two-Stage (decoupled)
two_stage.source: QoS-blind cover, then shallow repair hovers; the standard decoupled approach this paper's coupling is measured against

coupled_greedy.label: Coupled-Greedy (ablation)
coupled_greedy.source: QoS-aware coupled planner WITHOUT the local search; an ablation of the proposed method, not an independent baseline

atom3d.label: Strong-Coupled (deterministic)
atom3d.source: QoS-aware coupled planner; NOT the trained CMDP policy

regime: budget-constrained (Q4/Q6): every method flies until the mission energy budget B = 83 kJ is spent, so energy is comparable by construction and the comparison is the QoS that budget buys. QoS below 100% means the budget ran out, not that a constraint was violated.
note: Deterministic planners on the frozen synthetic city. No slot holds a learned policy - see each slot's 'source'. 'two_stage' is the baseline the contribution is measured against; 'coupled_greedy' is an ablation of 'atom3d', not an independent method.
